english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for two matching things taken together or two people forming a couple.
Use this for two matching or associated things considered as a pair, including a romantic couple when the pair is viewed as a unit.

examples.english: This pair of shoes goes well with my trousers.
examples.jyutping: ni1 jat1 deoi3 haai4 hou2 can3 ngo5 tiu4 fu3

examples.english: I bought a couple of matching sneakers.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 deoi3 bo1 haai4

english.note: Use 一對 when item means two people understood as a romantic couple.

examples.english: They really are an item; they go out together all the time.
examples.traditional: 佢哋真係一對，成日一齊出街。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 zan1 hai6 jat1 deoi3 seng4 jat6 jat1 cai4 ceot1 gaai1
